title: VATSIM Hours Burn-Up vs Rating Goal
dataSources: Flight logs (`flight:log`), flight-plan snapshots (`simbrief:plan`), network sessions (`vatsim:session`), prep tasks (`checkride:prep`), export syncs (`flight:export`).
app: Aviation and flight-sim telemetry — ForeFlight exports, SimBrief flight plans, VATSIM session logs, and checkride-prep trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vatsim:session rating_goal=* session_hours=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(session_hours) as metric by _time rating_goal
| sort 0 _time rating_goal
description: Trends monthly session hours by rating goal for VATSIM progression.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether VATSIM progression are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `rating_goal` on `vatsim:session` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly session hours.
visualization: Line chart of monthly session hours by rating goal.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how session hours changes month by month for each rating goal so you can see whether VATSIM progression are heading the right way.
